info.title: HexDB REST API
info.description: HexDB's REST API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API key or session token>` or the `hexdb_session` cookie (admin UI). Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`. See MANUAL.md for filters, aggregations, permissions and everything else.
